newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Kinetic to invest in car plant.
newsitem.headline: India's Kinetic to invest in car plant.

text.p: Indian scooter maker Kinetic Engineering Ltd said on Monday that it plans to invest one billion rupees ($28 million) to set up a car manufacturing plant.

Joint managing director Sulajja Firodia Motwani told reporters in the southern city of Bangalore that the plant will start operating by the end of 1998. "We plan to hit the road by end 1998," she said.
She said the company will invest one billion rupees to set up the plant at one of the group's existing factory sites near the western city of Pune.
The plant will have an initial production capacity of 20,000 cars a year, she said.
Motwani said Kinetic has already entered into technical collaboration with U.S.-based Briggs and Stratton and Ankin of France.
The proposed car will have a 500-cc engine and be priced at 125,000 rupees, she said.
Motwani said most of the initial capital will be raised internally and the rest through debt. ($1 = 35.7 rupees)
